scope: Seven previously absent P0/P1 keys per locale; 21 candidate values. Existing 334 accepted values per locale are unchanged and not re-reviewed.

verification.review: Bounded model-based source/terminology/meaning self-review only; not independent or native-human review.
verification.candidate_encoding: Decoded display strings, not XML-escaped resource fragments. Curly apostrophes are literal Unicode.
